notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (customer success analytics) evaluating Redwood for embeddings + semantic search. Current stack: Postgres + pgvector for prototyping, S3 object store for raw docs, running nightly batch jobs to re-embed changed docs. Primary pain: cost and predictability of large nightly batches + slow vector search at scale.

POC / technical requirements (shorthand):
- Workload: embeddings-heavy. Nightly batch: ~500k vectors (initial POC), target steady-state 2M vectors/month. Online queries: 95th pct <120ms prefer <100ms for top-k retrieval (k=10).
- Throughput target: embed 3k-5k vectors/min during batch windows; support on-demand smaller batches during business hours without impacting online latency.
- Vector DB: current PG+pgvector wants to remain (metadata filters, SQL joins). Evaluating Pinecone/Weaviate for production; require Redwood to integrate with both (outbound to vector DB endpoints) and also support direct export to S3 for archival.
- Model preferences: open, embedding models compatible with OpenAI embeddings API (we test text-embedding-3-small and an open-text-sim model). Cost sensitivity -> fallback to smaller embedder for low-priority docs.
- Routing/fallback: hosted -> use smaller model during budget spikes; Dedicated -> capacity guarantee with autoscale/burst. Need transparent per-vector cost breakdown.
- Security/compliance: must support SSO (SAML/Okta), SOC2 report, KMS for envelope encryption, audit logs shipped to their SIEM. Data residency: prefer NA-region only for POC and prod.
- Operational: want job idempotency, retry semantics, ability to run incremental embedding jobs (only changed docs), and TTL for cache. Request logs/traces for failed vectors.

POC success criteria (customer-facing):
- Achieve embeddings throughput >=3k vectors/min for sustained 30m window in Hosted API POC.
- End-to-end push -> vector DB insert latency <3s per vector in bulk ingest tests.
- Cost per 1M vectors below their internal threshold (~$X, benchmark required).
- Integration with pgvector metadata filters validated by sample queries.
- Security checklist: SAML + SOC2 attestation confirmed.

Call notes / quotes (fragments):
- "Cost predictability is top priority — we need to know monthly spend at 2M vectors." — Head of Product
- "We like Redwood's routing/fallback idea; can you show dedicated sizing for consistent QPS?" — CTO
- "Prefer to keep pgvector for joins; don't want to refactor everything to a new vector DB yet." — Engineering lead

Internal AE/SE notes:
- Customer leans Hosted first to validate throughput and integration, then move to Dedicated for predictable unit economics.
- Need to produce a dedicated sizing + committed pricing proposal. Ask Infra to model 16-32 GPU-month reserve for heavy batch windows.
- Confirm SAML metadata exchange and legal DPA timeline (legal assigned 2 weeks).

Attachments & references: pricing deck (drive), embeddings sample csv (drive), security questionnaire (jira SEC-1189).
